description: Capabilities for the print windows, which render document-derived HTML and so get only what printing needs: events to receive the content and report back, the print call (macOS `window.print` shim) and the log for the global error handler. The windows are created in Rust (commands/print.rs) on the app's own print page. This narrows plugin and core permissions only: the app's own Rust commands are not capability-gated (no app ACL manifest), so these windows can still call them.
